sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair (neuter status not recorded), had vomiting on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30, her latest entries (burden flag), and an AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed.
Vomiting is logged over at least 47 days, 23 entries on 23 of 43 logged days, first on May 14, her first entry of any kind, so onset is unknown.
Intake not directly observed: Nature's Variety Duck and Royal Canin Weight Care are free-fed all day, start not recorded, and no food could be isolated.
She was logged on 43 of 90 days, 4 of the first 45 and 39 of the last 45, with nothing logged Jul 1 to 2.
